def select_app_password(password_records, app_name):
    normalized = [(record['account_name'].strip().lower(), record['password']) for record in password_records]
    exact = [password for name, password in normalized if name == app_name]
    if len(exact) == 1:
        return exact[0]
    related = [password for name, password in normalized if app_name in name]
    if len(related) == 1:
        return related[0]
    raise ValueError(f'Could not uniquely select credentials for {app_name}')
